newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cades to tap its three Ffr bonds Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: Cades to tap its three Ffr bonds Nov 13.

text.p: French welfare debt repayment fund CADES said on Wednesday it will sell more of its existing French franc bonds, maturing in 2002, 2005 and 2007, at auction on November 13.
The fund said in a statement the minimum amount it would sell would be one billion francs for each issue. The auction will take place at 1000 GMT.
The bonds to be sold next week will be fungible with the existing bonds of the same maturities.
The payment date for the bond sales will be November 20.

The fund said the auction process would be the same as that for regular Treasury government bond auctions. That includes the option to buy more of the bonds after the auction at the average price of the competitive sale, the statement said.
The announcement was expected today and the details were in line with expectations.
The three bonds to be sold will be the 5.5 percent April 25 2002 bond, SICOVAM code 019793, the 6.00 percent July 25 2005 bond, code 020728 and the 6.25 percent October 25 2007 bond, code 019794.
The results of the auction will be publised on Reuters page CADEV, the statement said.
